Womit der Kessel rechnet. Die Anlage ken:
The fuel the boiler is set up for. The system offers four settings:

• Wood chips normal — moisture content 15 to 30 %, ash content up to 1.5 %
• Wood chips wet — over 30 %, at most 35 % moisture content
• Wood chips normal slaggy — 15 to 30 % moisture, ash content over 1.5 to about 3 %
• Wood chips wet slaggy — over 30 % moisture, ash content over 1.5 to about 3 %

“Slaggy” shows as hard lumps in the ash; the system then extends the de-ashing intervals. Below 25 % moisture content, the manufacturer advises against “wet”. After a change of fuel, check the ash: too much charcoal residue points back to “normal” or “wet”.

The change only takes effect after the boiler has been switched off and on again at the main switch.
Fährt den Kessel auf eine feste Leistung:
Runs the boiler at a fixed output and holds it, so that the flue gas measurement takes place under constant conditions. Without this function, the boiler modulates during the measurement and the result is useless.

The output is requested before the start; the chimney sweep says which value applies. How long the function keeps running is shown under “Chimney sweep” — zero means it is not running.

After the set chimney sweep run time, the boiler returns to normal operation on its own. To stop earlier, switch chimney sweep mode off again.
Nimmt Kessel und Rührwerk in Betrieb, da:
Starts the boiler and the agitator, so that the agitator turns while the storage room is being filled.

Without a turning agitator, the storage room may only be filled up to a height of about one metre — above that the agitator can be damaged, and the warranty does not cover it. Only when “released” is shown here may blowing in continue.

With pneumatic feed, release only follows once the hopper is empty; it must therefore be run empty first.
Meldet der Anlage, dass die Arbeit erled:
Tells the system that the work has been done and resets the corresponding cleaning request. Each button only affects its own counter.

Before cleaning, switch the boiler off via service burn-off. Only confirm when the cleaning has really been done — otherwise the system will report too late next time.
Lädt den Warmwasserspeicher einmalig auf:
Charges the hot water tank once, even during a blocking period of the hot water program.

The system only starts when the hot water temperature is below the set value by the switch-on hysteresis. The hysteresis is set under “Start at deviation”; the factory setting is 5 K. The set temperature is the switch-off point.
Wie der Heizkreis gefahren wird:\n\n• St:
How the heating circuit is operated:

• Standby — heating off, frost protection only
• Program 1 to 3 — operation according to the respective time program
• Heating mode — permanently at the heating mode setpoint
• Setback mode — permanently at the setback setpoint
• Manual mode — manual control

On the boiler, the operating mode means something else: there it switches between off, on and the special operating modes.
Der eigene Fühlereingang des Pumpen-/Rel:
The pump/relay module's own sensor input — not the boiler itself.

The module measures the temperature of the pipe it is mounted on and controls by it: when an external heat request arrives at its input, it requests heat until this value reaches the set target temperature.

What the sensor physically measures depends on the wiring; the system cannot report it. Which task the module has — pump control, external heat request or collective fault message — is shown in the datapoints of group 29 at service level.
Wie weit der Mischer geöffnet ist. 0 % h:
How far the mixing valve is open. 0 % means only return water is circulated; the circuit gets no heat from the boiler. 100 % means full flow.

In between, the valve mixes cooler return water into the flow until the flow temperature matches the heating curve. In the diagram, the pointer in the valve swings accordingly, and the section of pipe above it changes colour from blue to red.
Die Automatik verschiebt, was die Anlage: The automation shifts what the system does anyway. On a sunny day it lowers the setpoint for a limited time; the setback ends at the controller on its own. In the transition season it switches the heating circuit to hot water only, and back again in cooler weather. Each room counts against its own target; thermostats supply it themselves. In observation mode it writes nothing and shows in the log what it would have done. A manual operation pauses it until 05:00. Below 16 °C in the room it immediately reverts any intervention of its own.
Die eingestellte Warmwassertemperatur is: The set hot water temperature is the switch-off point. Charging starts as soon as the temperature drops below it by the switch-on hysteresis; the factory setting is 5 K.

Ohne Heizung ab jetzt: nach {h} h {k} K: Without heating from now: {k} K cooler after {h} h ({von} → {nach} °C), at {aussen} °C outdoors
Die Zahl ist die Zeitkonstante des Hause: The figure is the time constant of the house per DIN V 18599-2. In this time a room without heating loses almost two thirds of its difference to the outdoor temperature. The larger it is, the longer the house holds the heat. A rating such as light or heavy appears only with a documented scale.
Nur Beobachtung: gemessene Werte, keine: Observation only: measured values, no recommendation. The analysis changes nothing on the system.
Geprüft wird, ob der Heizkreis bei der e: Checks whether the heating circuit heats at the set heating limit (OT heating mode). For each day, the mean outdoor temperature counts and whether the circuit heated for at least two hours. If the measured limit differs by more than 2 K, something else limits heating, such as thermostats, an empty buffer or heat from elsewhere.
Erzeugte Wärme aus Kesselleistung und Ne: Heat produced from boiler output and rated output, without the base load on days without heating. Degree days per VDI 3807 remove the weather, so years can be compared. They count every day whose outdoor mean is below the standard's heating limit, as 20 °C minus the daily mean. This limit is a fixed calculation value, 15 °C in Germany, 12 °C in Austria and Switzerland, and not a setting of the system. The value applies to the whole system. A day also counts as a heating day when a system without its own boiler that it supplies was heating.
Ohne eingestellte Heizgrenze kein Vergle: No comparison without a set heating limit.
Heizgrenze der Gradtagzahl (VDI 3807, fe: Degree-day heating limit (VDI 3807, fixed calculation value)
Hinweise der Auswertung in der Seitenlei: Report analysis notes in the sidebar
{name}: Die Auswertung meldet einen Hinw: {name}: The analysis reports a note on {befunde}.
Die eigene Anordnung des Reiters „{reite: Discard your own layout of the “{reiter}” tab and return to the default layout?
A notice with no action required.
Ein Fehler sollte zeitnah geprüft werden: An error should be checked soon.

Verglichen werden Brennerstarts je Gradt: Burner starts per degree day are compared between heating days with an automation intervention and heating days without. An intervention means at least two hours of sunny day, heating pause, hot water only or absence. A degree day here is 20 °C minus the daily mean outside. The automation tends to act on mild, sunny days, so the value shows a correlation, not proof.
Starts je Gradtag mit Automatik gegenübe: Starts per degree day with automation compared to without
Die Räume liegen meist mehr als 0,5 K üb: The rooms are mostly more than 0.5 K above target. The heating circuit supplies more heat than they take. According to the Windhager manual: lower the design temperature or base point, or reduce comfort.
Die Steuerung setzt die Störung am Kesse: The controller resets the fault at the boiler. Controllers from version 2 clear it with this, including a locking one. Has the cause been fixed?
Der Eintrag verschwindet aus der Meldung: The entry disappears from the message list of the control panel.
Die Meldung gilt als erledigt und schlie: The message counts as done and closes on the control panel. A fault at the boiler remains as long as its cause is present.
Gilt für alle Reiter und das Schaubild,: Applies to all tabs and the diagram, only for you.

Ab hier darf die Sonne einen Eingriff au: From this time on, sunshine may trigger an intervention. Other reasons, such as a mild outdoor temperature, apply at any time.
Gilt, wenn als frühester Beginn eine fes: Applies when a fixed time is selected as the earliest start.
So viele Prüfungen in Folge, alle fünf M: An intervention must stay the same for this many checks in a row, one every five minutes, before it starts.
So viele Prüfungen in Folge muss das End: The end of an intervention must stay the same for this many checks in a row. Cold rooms and safety end it immediately.
So lange bleibt ein neuer Zustand mindes: A new state lasts at least this long. Cold rooms and safety take precedence.
